'''Bakku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reigat]], who was a member of [[Sleeper Cell V-16]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Bakku lived in [["Downside"|Downside]], a slum area in [[Fabrillan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]]. He worked as strong man for a local gang leader there and also carried out duties as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at her bar. Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he was the muscle for [[Sleeper Cell V-16]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[sleeper cell]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Bakku was quiet, intimidating and anti-social. He joined the Alliance because they let him be that way, rather than imposing rules and regulations onto him, like the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] did.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Bakku was a fearsome combatant with exceptional strength and skill in hand-to-hand combat. He was also well skilled in a variety of weaponry, including [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Bakku would typically carry a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|Vibro-ax]] and a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]]. He had a weapons cache that contained a variety of explosives and six [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|Fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakku was designed by [[Ed Stark|Ted Stark]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Brian Schomburg]].
